Rules & How to Play

Pick six players and compete to score the most touchdowns in your group.
PickQB · RB · RB · WR · WR · TE
QBPassing TDs
OthersRushing + Receiving TDs
WinMost total TDs
Full Rules

1. Build Your Lineup

  • Select 1 QB, 2 RBs, 2 WRs, and 1 TE.
  • Choose players from any matchup on the weekly slate.
  • Each player can only appear once in a lineup.

2. Scoring

  • QB=Passing TD’s only
  • RB=Rushing and Receiving TD’s only
  • WR=Receiving and Rushing TD’s only
  • TE=Receiving and Rushing TD’s only
  • Your total score is the combined touchdown total within your lineup.

3. Tiebreaker

  • Before submitting a lineup, predict the total number of touchdowns that will be scored across the entire NFL slate that week.
  • All NFL touchdowns count, including passing, rushing, receiving, defensive, special teams, quarterback rushing, kick-return, and punt-return touchdowns.
  • The tiebreaker is used only when two or more lineups finish with the same TD6 score. The closest prediction wins.
  • Players’ tiebreaker predictions become visible to the group after the weekly slate locks.

4. Contest Timing

Every contest locks when the first game of the weekly slate begins. No entries or lineup changes are allowed after the lock. The contest ends after the final game of the weekly slate is completed.

5. Join a Group

Build and submit a lineup, then choose a group to enter. You can also select a group first and build a lineup specifically for it. You may enter each group only once.

6. Create a Group

Open the Groups tab, choose Public or Private, name the group, and create it. Private groups require the password you set before another player can enter.

7. Lineups & Leaderboards

Your saved entries appear under My Lineups. Open a group's leaderboard to follow the standings. Other players' lineups become visible after the contest locks.
